titulo.alumno: Describing a debate with をめぐって

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it adds in context.

piezas.titulo: をめぐって introduces an issue that provokes debate, dispute or several positions.
texto: It usually appears with 話し合う, 議論する, 対立する. The expression alone does not say who is right.
駅前 の 土地 を めぐって、住民 と 事業者 の 話し合い が 続いて います。 (Talks between residents and the company about the land in front of the station are ongoing.)
計画 の 費用 負担 を めぐり、二つ の 案 が 提示 されました。 (Two proposals were presented regarding the sharing of the plan's costs.)
